notes.title: Welcome Fellow Hillgoers !
notes.content:
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FarmerAndTree/]Join Reddit Community[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/FVgKyyR]Join Discord Server[/url]

【No planting/no reservation】

It's offline! Please exit and re-enter the game.

-----.

【Planting】

16 hours for the seeds to germinate, 48 hours to grow, no need to turn on the game and wait!

-----.

【Get your card】

You don't have to open the game on time to get your card after booking!

After the time has passed, you can even open the game and receive it! A day later, a week later, a month later!!!!

-----.

【Sheshen】

Sheshen is the oldest tree currently. Relates to unlocking the plot.

-----.

【I didn't get my card】

Please exit the game to reenter and be patient for a minute or so.

Note: Look at the reservation screen and make sure there's a red flower marking yesterday's reservation!

-----.

【Basic key instructions】

Esc: Exit the game

Tab: Switch to full screen

↑↓←→ : Turn page

Mouse wheel: Zoom in/out

-----.

【Piano】

SDFGHJK,ERYUI 12 piano keys in pitch: CDEFGAB,C#D#F#G#A#

Hold down the ↑ or ↓ keys while pressing the piano key for the corresponding higher or lower octave note.

Pressing the piano key while holding down the ← or → key pushes the note bubbles left and right.

Use the piano keys to collect the pitch bubbles, and the volume increases when you collect them.

The numeric keys 1 and 2 adjust the default piano volume level, and the numeric keys 3 and 4 adjust the piano volume level when collecting note bubbles.

-----.

【Visit other hills】

Click on the gear icon in the bottom left corner to open the door and allow visit.

When the egret stops, double-click on the egret to travel to another hill.

If there are no egrets, plant a few more trees.

(Don't forget to pick a seed then double click Rich Fu and tell him your name! (Usually you can also exchange seeds with other hill friends by patting Fu)
